about: Known-target questions for `make eval-retrieval`. Each was written by a model from one crawled posting, in two forms: `natural` names the job, `paraphrased` describes it without its title or any technology. The posting is found by its URL. Postings close and are pruned after 30 days, so the set shrinks; the command says how many are left.
